result.edit: The failure occurs at cycle 24 when checking the sequence 011100. The current implementation incorrectly makes the next state after sf6 dependent on the input data, causing an incorrect output when the sequence is matched. By removing this data dependency and always transitioning to sf1 from sf6, we preserve the group boundary behavior specified - after processing 6 bits, the FSM should reset to check the next group regardless of the input value. This change ensures correct output classification for matched sequences while maintaining the required group separation.
